title: Hero FinCorp IPO
summary: Hero FinCorp IPO is an issue of about ₹3,668 crore, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Hero FinCorp IPO has a total issue size of Approx 3,668 Crores and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

Hero FinCorp financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

A diversified financial services company, Hero FinCorp offers two-wheeler financing, advances for buying homes in the affordable housing segment, loans for education, and lends to the small and medium enterprise sector. The lender has presence in over 4,000 cities and towns across India and nearly 2,000 retail financing touchpoints within Hero MotoCorp's network.
